caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, ankle-length dress with a fitted upper body and a flared skirt. The dress has a pointed collar and a cinched waistline. The main pattern of the dress consists of alternating rows of geometric and medallion-like motifs in red, green, brown, white, and blue, set against a predominantly dark, possibly black or navy, speckled background. Along the hem of the skirt, there is a border featuring repeating letters in red on a grayish background. The sleeves are gathered at the cuffs, adding volume. To the right side of the main colored illustration, there is a light pencil sketch showing the outline and construction of the same dress, including seam details and the cuffs, without any color or patterning. The entire composition is set on an off-white or beige paper background.
title: Wrapper
